scope_note: NET GAIN(LOSS) counts the dispositions in these books (plus the T5 box 18 dividends [[capital_gains_dividends]] names, when `tjs carryover` passes them). Other capital gains reported on slips (T3 box 21, T5 box 18 -> lines 17400/17600) and the ITA s.39(1.1) FX gain or loss on foreign cash (line 15300, `tjs fx-cash`) are NOT included; in a loss year they change the net capital loss, so the carryforward and the carryback caps shown are off by that amount.
